head: codex/4760-v0918-wp14-preparation
title: [v0.91.8][WP-21] Implement Memory Palace context handoff
body:
Closes #4760

## Summary

Implements the bounded Memory Palace MVP handoff for long-lived agents. The new `memory_palace` module consumes declared ObsMem-shaped records, preserves Chronosense-compatible temporal anchors and continuity ids, builds deterministic topology/working-set/stale-context packets, and fails closed on missing provenance, private/absolute references, continuity mismatch, stale context, and future effective anchors.

The long-lived-agent cycle path now emits `memory_palace_context.json` when configured, includes it in `decision_request.memory_refs`, sanitizes it with the public artifact set, and records the packet reference in `cycle_manifest.json`. Unconfigured agents keep the prior empty `memory_refs` behavior.
